title: edikt governance-verifier verdict (L2)
description: Per-directive verdict emitted by the L2 governance-verifier agent. A sibling of the L1 evaluator-verdict schema. Per-directive, no evidence_type discriminator, no BLOCKED — L2 runs in a fresh read-only fork that can always evaluate.

verdicts.description: One entry per directive evaluated. May be empty when the diff matches no directives in the topic file; meta is still required.

directive_id.description: Stable directive identifier. Either an ADR/INV-anchored directive index (e.g. 'INV-NNN.directive[0]') or a topic-anchored directive index (e.g. 'governance-security.directive[3]').

status.description: Per-directive verdict. PASS = diff is consistent with directive (or unrelated). FAIL = diff demonstrably violates directive; cite file/line in evidence. NEEDS_REVIEW = diff plausibly touches directive but cannot be determined without information not in the prompt. There is no BLOCKED — the verifier runs in a fresh read-only fork and can always evaluate.

rationale.description: Short human-readable justification. Plain text only — markdown code fences are rejected, preventing shell-content leakage from agent output into downstream systemMessage channels.

evidence.description: Optional file/line citations. Used for FAIL verdicts to ground the violation in the diff. PASS verdicts may omit this field; FAIL verdicts SHOULD include at least one entry (fixture-tested separately, not schema-enforced).

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file the directive is violated in.

line_range.description: Line span in the diff, e.g. '42-58' or '42'.

topic.description: Compiled governance topic the directives came from (matches .claude/rules/governance/<topic>.md basename).

ran_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the verifier run.

agent_version.description: Version stamp of the governance-verifier agent template that produced this verdict.
